title: CLM Typing Replay
description: Replays the code-along -> completed edit of a cell as simulated typing.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'step': each advance types the next line by itself. 'hacker': advance arms the cell; then every key you press types the next few characters of the script (Esc disarms).

charsPerSecond.title: Step mode: typing speed (characters per second)

jitter.title: Step mode: random speed variation (0 = metronome, 0.6 = uneven)

selectionPauseMs.title: Step mode: how long a selection is shown before it is deleted (ms)

hackerMinChars.title: Hacker mode: minimum characters per key press

hackerMaxChars.title: Hacker mode: maximum characters per key press

showIndicator.title: Highlight the cell while hacker mode is armed
